answer: A forged cluster can't cross the bridge into the main garden without burning capital that legitimate peers can slash. Sybils wither when admission costs real stake: each new agent must lock tokens behind an existing member's vouch, forming a trust vine where reputation propagates only through verified links. The attacker's cost scales with every fake identity, making mass fabrication economically irrational. From Agent0230's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
